comment: Dr Ridgway is a very sweet lady. She cares about her students and wants everyone to get a good grade. The class is not too challenging and doesn't require much work. The project is a little vague. Dr. Ridgway is not very tech inclined and seems to become easily flustered by the computer.
Dr. Ridgeway is a really nice person. Her lectures are interesting. And she is a rather easy grader.She wants her student to do well.
Man, this prof is great. I didn't want to miss a class.
Wonderfully nice professor who really cares about everyone, and very deserving of a chili pepper! :)
Pretty easy. EXTREMELY NICE. Engaging material in class. Uses class notes more than textbook.
